paragraphs: This section outlines the learning outcomes for the project, which focuses on integrating various microcontroller peripherals and libraries to achieve specific functionality.
bullets: Understand how to configure and use GPIO pins for input and output operations.
Master the use of ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) to measure analog signals like soil moisture.
Learn to configure Timers for periodic tasks such as blinking an LED or controlling a motor.
Implement UART communication to send and receive data over USB, which is crucial for debugging and telemetry.
